vulnerabilities.description: Local File Inclusion in Flask app - 'file' parameter allows directory traversal to read arbitrary files
LFI used to read /home/opuser/.ssh/id_rsa - exposes SSH private key
SUID bit set on find binary for privilege escalation from opuser to root

scenarios.name: Reconnaissance
scenarios.description: Nmap scan to discover open ports

scenarios.name: LFI Exploitation & SSH Key Extraction
scenarios.description: Exploit LFI to read opuser's SSH private key
expected_findings: id_rsa with BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY header
scenarios.success_criteria: SSH private key extracted via LFI

scenarios.name: SSH Authentication via Private Key
scenarios.description: Use extracted SSH private key to authenticate via SSH
scenarios.success_criteria: SSH login successful with extracted private key

scenarios.name: Privilege Escalation & Flag Capture
scenarios.description: Use SUID find to escalate to root and capture flags
scenarios.success_criteria: Root shell obtained, both flags extracted

safety_invariants: SI-01: All commands must pass through authorize_shell_command()
SI-02: No dangerous commands in objective_command_map
SI-03: Every shell session must have dual-gate auth
SI-05: Dead shell sessions detected via 15s timeout -> TERMINATED
SI-06: Only authorized commands within ENGAGEMENT_CONFIG scope execute
SI-07: All commands must be logged with timestamp and outcome
SI-08: Falsification deduplication requires content_hash matching
